KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_DEPARTURE_: The Expedition departure window is now open.
The Expedition departure window is now closed.
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_DESCRIPTIO: You missed the departure window for this Expedition. Fortunately, all the progress you’ve made in building your caravan will carry over to the next Expedition. If you have any remaining work to do on your caravan, you can pick up right where you left off. If it’s finished in time for the next departure window, you’ll be able to send your Raider on the Expedition.
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_SUBTITLE: Construct a caravan to send your Raider off on an Expedition beyond the Rust Belt.
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_DESCRIPTIO: Expeditions are perilous. Your Raider will carry all their possessions into the unknown beyond the Rust Belt. In return, your next Raider gains a unique edge that lasts until the next Expedition departs.
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPLANATION_OVERVIEW_: Undertaking an Expedition means your Raider leaves the Rust Belt for good. Preparing your caravan takes time and resources, and once it departs, much of your progress will be reset. Some rewards and advantages carry over to your next Raider, lasting until the next Expedition begins. These advantages can be increased by continuing to send Raiders on future Expeditions.
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPLANATION_RANKS_DES: Completing an Expedition gives your new Raider lasting advantages until the next Expedition departs. These include increased XP gain, extra Scrappy materials, increased weapon repairs, and more stash space. You can also earn bonus skill points based on the value of the items in your stash upon departure.
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPLANATION_CALENDAR_:
Expeditions run on a set schedule, with each preparation stage unlocking after the previous one is complete. You’ll have 60 days to gather resources and complete your caravan build. Once construction is finished and the departure sign-up window opens, you can sign your Raider up for departure and view the rewards that will carry over to your next Raider.
Missing an Expedition departure window means losing its buffs until the next cycle, so plan your contributions and availability ahead of time.
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPLANATION_STEPS_DES: Preparing for an Expedition happens in five stages, each requiring specific resources or items. You will construct a caravan, stock it with supplies, and then leave everything behind to depart. First, you will lay the foundation, install the core systems, construct the framework, and outfit the caravan for travel. Lastly, you will load it with as many supplies as it can carry.
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPLANATION_DETAILS_D: When your Raider departs on an Expedition, some things are reset and others are kept for your next Raider.
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPLANATION_DETAILS_K: Bonus Skill Points Earned From Expeditions
Bonus Stash Slots Earned From Expeditions
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_STEP_1_DES: Building the base structure and frame of the caravan.
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_STEP_2_DES: Connecting wiring, ventilation, and essential power systems.
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_STEP_3_DES: Building walls and roof, installing core systems, and defining the interior layout.
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_STEP_4_DES: Adding storage, workbenches, utilities, and personal touches.
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_STEP_USE_D: Once committed to your project, resources cannot be retrieved
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_STEP_5_DES: Loading the caravan with vital supplies.
Combat gear, survival equipment, provisions, and repair materials are needed to fully prepare for the Expedition.
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_DEPARTURE_:
Your caravan is stocked with all necessities and ready to depart on the Expedition. Once the departure window opens, you can sign up your Raider for departure, sending them beyond the borders of the Rust Belt for good.
When the Expedition departs, all items remaining in your Raider’s stash will be contributed to it, and your next Raider can earn up to five skill points based on the total value of those items.

Your caravan is fully stocked, and your Raider is signed up to depart with the Expedition.
When the Expedition departs, all items remaining in your Raider’s stash will be contributed to it, and your next Raider can earn up to five skill points based on the total value of those items.

If you choose to sign up, your Raider will depart Speranza with the Expedition and your progress will be reset. When they return, it will be as a new Raider, carrying the rewards of a completed Expedition.
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_SKIP_TUTOR: Do you want to skip the tutorial level?
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_DEPARTUREV: Since arriving in Speranza, your Raider has left an undeniable mark.
Their adventures will be the subject of bold tales for a long time to come.
Most value gained in a single round:
Most value lost in a single round:
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_DEPARTURE_:
Your caravan is stocked with all necessities and ready to depart on the Expedition. You can now sign up your Raider for departure, sending them beyond the borders of the Rust Belt for good.
When the Expedition departs, all items remaining in your Raider’s stash will be contributed to it, and your next Raider can earn up to five skill points based on the total value of those items.
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_GRACE_DESC:
You missed the window to sign up for departure. You have a chance to leave now, your Raider will depart immediately and your progress will be reset. Any bonuses you have not fulfilled requirements for, will be available to catch up with the upcoming Expeditions.

If you rather stay behind you will lose any temporary buffs. Your caravan’s progress will be saved, so you can depart with the next Expedition.
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_LOADOUT_WA: Losing these items may impact the value of your Expedition.
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_CANTINA_WI: You are not ready to sign up for departure. Your caravan still needs work.
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_SIGNUP_WIN: The window to sign up for departure is open!
The sign-up window for the Expedition has opened! If your caravan is fully built, you can now register your Raider for departure.
The window to sign up for departure opens on {0}.
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_COMPLETE_D: You have successfully completed your Expedition Project and sent your Raider into the unknown. Your new Raider will enjoy a long-term buff to XP gain and stash space, benefit from increased repair efficiency, and receive extra materials from Scrappy. This buff will last until the next Expedition departs, but it can be kept and improved if you choose to send your new Raider on that Expedition as well.
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_WINTER_DESCRIPTION: A festival of resilient warmth, centered around the hardy candleberry bush.
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_WINTER_STAGE_1_DESCRI: The namesake use for the candleberry, Speranzans boil the fruit into a thick wax that burns cleanly and fragrantly.
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_WINTER_STAGE_2_DESCRI: Many Speranzans have become surprisingly adept at the art of bringing beauty and greenery into the home.
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_WINTER_STAGE_3_DESCRI: Crafty Speranzans have turned the candleberries into a wealth of gifts. These include perfumes and soaps, as well as gifts unrelated to the recipient's odors.
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_WINTER_STAGE_4_DESCRI: Candleberries can be crushed into refreshing juices, while the leaves and roots make for a tea that can drive out the toughest of colds.
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_WINTER_STAGE_5_DESCRI: Though candleberry leaves are bitter, simmering them in stew and soups adds a touch of earthiness that nostalgic Speranzans have grown to love.
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_WINTER_COMPLETED_DESC: The preparations for your banquet are now complete! It’s time to kick back, make a toast, and quietly bask in the envious glances of uninvited passers-by.
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_TROPHYCASE_OVERVIEW_D: Use ARC parts to build a display of your hunting trophies, in order to not-so-subtly shut down anyone who questions the bold tales of your topside adventures.
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_TROPHYCASE_PROJECT_CO: Your trophy display is complete! All that remains is to loiter about while Speranzans gasp, gawk and linger at the indisputable evidence of your topside accomplishments.
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_ABOUT_DESC: Undertaking an Expedition means your Raider leaves the Rust Belt for good. Preparing your caravan takes time and resources, and when it departs, much of your progress resets. Some rewards carry over to your next Raider until the next Expedition.
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_GAIN_LOSE_: When you take part in the Expedition, everything tied to your Raider gets reset, such as your items, skills, workshop, Raider Den, and quests. You keep everything tied to your Embark account, such as your Raider Tokens, all Raider Deck progress, unlocked cosmetics, existing temporary buffs, and any permanent rewards earned from previous Expeditions. You will gain any additional temporary buffs this Expedition grants you.
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_STEPS_DESC:
Build a caravan to be able to depart on an Expedition. Once your caravan is completed, you can sign up as soon as the departure window opens.

If you miss the departure, you will lose any temporary buffs until the next Expedition. However, any permanent rewards from past Expeditions will be retained.
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_DEPARTURE_: The departure window for the Expedition opens once the Trials Season ends.
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_BONUS_DESC: You can earn bonus rewards during the remainder of the departure window. When you finally depart at the end of the window, all remaining items in your stash will be contributed to the Expedition.
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_CATCHUP_DE: Missed earlier Expedition bonus rewards? You will have a chance to catch up during the departure window.
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_PROGRESS_K: If you miss the departure, your caravan's building progress is carried over to the next Expedition. You'll be able to pick up where you left off.
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_BUFFER_REA: Your caravan is stocked and ready. When the departure window opens, you can earn additional bonuses, and sign your Raider up to leave the Rust Belt for good. On departure, all remaining stash items are contributed.

Your caravan is stocked and ready. With the departure window open, you can sign your Raider up to leave the Rust Belt for good. On departure, all remaining stash items are contributed, and your next Raider can earn up to five skill points based on their total value.
Your caravan is stocked and ready. When the departure window opens, you can sign your Raider up to leave the Rust Belt for good.
Your caravan is stocked and ready. With the departure window open, you can sign your Raider up to leave the Rust Belt for good.
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_BUFFER_CAT: You have skill points from a previous Expedition to catch up on!
You have skill points from previous Expeditions to catch up on!
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_WEATHERSTATION_COMPLE: Your weather station is now up and running, and collecting a veritable wealth of data. Though the meteorological results will take some time to collect, you do have an immediate source of particularly captivating small talk.
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_SATELLITE_PAGE1_DESCR:
With ARC’s operations growing ever more destructive, generous rewards are being offered for the construction of high-gain antennas, to be deployed around the Rust Belt. 

When placed in open areas, these parabolic dishes can form an array that picks up on distant signals within a narrow beamwidth. Shani believes these may help triangulate the origins of the troubling ARC signals that were recently reported.
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_SATELLITE_PAGE2_DESCR: The antennas require rare components that can not be crafted. However, ARC’s ongoing operations offer a rare opportunity to collect the parts required to build your antenna.
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_SATELLITE_PAGE3_DESCR: After sufficient antennas have been constructed and weather conditions are safe, they will be deployed across the Rust Belt in hopes of triangulating the source of recent ARC signals.
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_SATELLITE_COMPLETED_D: Your high-gain antenna will be deployed around the Rust Belt once conditions are safe, and may help us triangulate the origins of the disturbing ARC signals.
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_BUFFER_CAT: You can catch up on bonuses from previous Expeditions.
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_DEPARTURE_: If you choose to sign up, your Raider will depart Speranza once the Expedition leaves, and return as a new one. This action cannot be undone.
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_EXPLANATIO: You will be able to catch up on any missed bonus rewards in future Expeditions.
You will be able to catch up on any missed bonus rewards in your next Expedition.
You will have the opportunity to catch up on any missed bonus rewards in your upcoming Expedition.

KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECT_EXPEDITION_LAST_STEP_P: With your caravan built, you have one last opportunity to truly cement your legacy before departure.
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECT_EXPEDITION_LAST_STEP_D: Put your spare gear to good use, and let your final triumphs reverberate throughout Speranza's cantinas long after you're gone.
Use your last gear to leave a mark that will remain long after you're gone.
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECT_EXPEDITION_AVIAN_ALARM: Speranzans have noticed that some birds are sensitive to atmospheric changes, and have taken to designing multi-tiered alarm systems to warn of impending danger. Though their precision has been debated, the calming effect of their companionship is beyond reproach.
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDER_PROJECT_EXPEDITION_LAST_RESORT: An apparent favorite pastime of resort guests, miniature ship models have been found all around the Riven Tides area. The dream of safety beyond the horizon has turned many Speranzans into avid collectors, and even the local bird population seems to have taken a shine to these fine models.
